purpose: Reusable external-source inventory for Project60 brain. This catalog does not modify the frozen Signal Lab TRIALS.json candidate lock.

sources.role: On-chain token discovery, market trends, holder/trader analysis, wallet history, smart-money/KOL tracking
sources.evidence: Maintainer README documents CLI skills and public demo key for read-only token/market/portfolio commands; demo key is test-only. Swap/order skills also exist.
sources.access: Public demo API key for read-only test commands; personal API key required for normal service; private key/order features not permitted.
sources.notes: No code importing private-key, swap, or order paths. Preserve raw source timestamps and chain identifiers.

sources.license: Check upstream license file before vendoring weights/code
sources.evidence: Published paper reports pretraining on over 12B candlestick records across 45 exchanges and zero-shot forecasting benchmarks; these are forecasting metrics, not live trading PnL.
sources.access: Model weights/dependencies required; Hugging Face availability and cloud inference compatibility must be checked; do not retrain or rerun vendor benchmark.
sources.notes: If HF host unavailable, mark BLOCKED and continue other sources.

sources.license: GPL-3.0 for Freqtrade core; verify each strategy file/repository license before copying
sources.role: Strategy library, indicators, exchange data interfaces, dry-run and backtest framework
sources.evidence: Official docs provide backtesting, dry-run, lookahead-analysis and recursive-analysis workflows; maintainers warn backtest can differ from live.
sources.access: Historical data for backtests; exchange public data for dry-run; keys only for authenticated/private endpoints or real execution.
allowed: reuse signal/indicator calculations subject to license
sources.notes: No repeated vendor backtest. Only strategies with pre-existing published evidence are marked vendor-validated; others remain source-only.

sources.role: Multi-agent analyst/researcher debate, sentiment/news/technical analysis, risk and portfolio reasoning
sources.evidence: Paper and repository publish historical stock benchmark results; README notes non-determinism and says framework is a research scaffold, not a fixed replicable-return strategy.
sources.access: Requires LLM provider API key; supports xAI/Grok among providers and several market/news data providers.
sources.notes: Use as independent analyst inputs, not an autonomous order agent.

sources.license: API service; not a repository license
sources.role: Live X keyword/semantic search, thread fetch, and remote read-only MCP tools
sources.evidence: Official xAI documentation describes X Search and remote MCP allow-listing.
sources.access: XAI_API_KEY required for API integration; X Search tool has usage-based charges; restrict allowed tools to read-only.
sources.notes: No official xAI trading-agent repository identified; Grok is a model/tool provider, not a trading strategy. Official docs list X Search usage pricing of $5 per 1,000 posts and $10 per 1,000 user profiles; limit handles/date windows/max turns to control spend. Remote MCP must use an explicit read-only allowed_tools list.

sources.license: Verify license at selected version before code reuse
sources.role: Unified market/financial data platform and agent-facing data access
sources.evidence: Official platform documentation and repository describe data APIs and agent integration.
sources.access: Provider-specific data sources may require API keys; some public providers are available.
sources.notes: Prioritize data normalization and source provenance over copying full platform.

sources.role: Quant research, data processing, ML modeling, portfolio/risk research
sources.evidence: Published platform paper and repository include end-to-end research/backtest pipeline; not a turnkey crypto signal service.
sources.access: Public historical datasets and configurable data providers.

sources.role: Modular quantitative trading stack with weight-centric strategy, risk, backtest and broker layers
sources.evidence: 2026 FinRL-X paper and project results; repo says educational/research use and includes live execution modules.
sources.access: Data providers and Alpaca integration; provider keys needed for some paths.
sources.notes: Primary repository for current FinRL-X, not legacy FinRL.

sources.role: Exchange connectors, order-book/websocket data, paper trading, market-making architecture
sources.evidence: Maintainer docs describe connector architecture and paper mode using live market data; users' reported volume is not a profitability benchmark.
sources.access: Paper market data can work without exchange keys; authenticated trading requires keys.
sources.notes: No bot deployment into protected Termux services.

sources.role: Deterministic event-driven multi-venue research/simulation engine and market data adapters
sources.evidence: Official docs describe event-driven backtesting, simulated exchange, latency/fill models and research/live semantic parity; not evidence of strategy profitability.
sources.access: Public market data adapters; live execution requires venue credentials.
sources.notes: Large Rust/Python engine; do not install in Termux.

sources.license: Verify current upstream license before code reuse
sources.role: Crypto strategy research and multi-timeframe/multi-symbol backtesting
sources.evidence: Official README describes backtesting and multiple timeframes/symbols; inspect its published docs for execution assumptions.
sources.access: Historical OHLCV; live exchange integration may require keys.

sources.role: Crypto automation, social/technical indicators, paper trading and exchange connectors
sources.evidence: Maintainer docs describe backtesting and live-data paper mode; beta interface is explicitly work in progress.
sources.access: Paper mode; exchange keys for authenticated trading features.
blocked: copying GPL code without license review

sources.role: File-driven AI trading agent, multi-provider reasoning, event log and guard pipeline
sources.evidence: Repository itself describes the software as experimental and warns against live trading.
sources.access: Provider authentication; broker integrations can be configured.
allowed: architecture concepts: event log, tool registry, guard separation
sources.notes: Not suitable for direct integration as a live agent.

sources.role: Cloud-hosted educational/research environment for LLM trading agents, explicit market rules, evaluation and orchestration
sources.evidence: Repository documentation describes backtests, agent customization and observation of agent behavior under market constraints; not evidence of live profitability.
sources.access: Hosted web app and source repository; credentials may be needed for external agent providers.
sources.notes: Research lab, not a signal provider.

allowed: discover new candidate repositories and papers
